public class Main {
    static long[] st = new long[18];
    static long[] a = new long[18];
    static long[] b = new long[18];
    static long[] c = new long[18];
    static long fans = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static void check() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            a[i] = c[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 17; i++) {
            if (b[i] > 0) {
                a[i + 1]++;
                a[i] -= 10;
                a[0]--;
            }
        }
        if (a[0] < -6) {
            a[0] += 11;
            a[1]--;
        }
        if (a[0] > 6) {
            a[0] -= 11;
            a[1]++;
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            ans += Math.abs(a[i]) * (i + 1);
        }
        if (ans < fans) {
            fans = ans;
        }
    }

    static void pereb(int step) {
        if (step >= 17) {
            check();
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            b[step] = i;
            pereb(step + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long cur = n;
        int pos = 17;
        while (cur > 0) {
            c[pos] = cur / st[pos];
            cur %= st[pos];
            pos--;
        }
        pereb(0);
        System.out.println(fans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
